title: Places · town
note: Places leaf. P1 Oxford fill: travel + town culture. Directions thinned of pure grammar. Sentence = fruit. · carriers via use[] · picture-led intro added 2026-08-07 · 2026-08-20 (James, smoke): "it's saying pred is not before". Bare před/za gave no way to know whether the place or the time sense was wanted — a1_time_numbers already marks před (časem) → ago, but the spatial pair was unmarked. Cues now say (místem), and před also accepts before, which the app teaches nowhere. · 2026-08-31 cap 60: journey/tourist/passport/vacation/flight/bicycle/policeman/university/theatre → A2. · 2026-08-31 sentence_gap flip: café → cafe (engine \b regex cannot gap a word ending in é); café kept as item accept. · split 2026-08-31 (James: 36-word cap = 3 rounds) → second half is a1_places_2. · 2026-08-31 intro split fix: split copied the item blocks but left the pre-split intro (all groups) in both halves; intro now shows only this half's words.

intro.note: go takes to before a place: I go to the bank, I go to the station. But home takes nothing at all: I go home, never I go to home.
intro.note_cz: go to the bank, ale jen go home — před home se to nedává.
